title: CBO budget-review summary (real PD figures, internal-arithmetic defects)

source.attribution: Congressional Budget Office (U.S. Government work, public domain)
source.notes: Figures are the real CBO Monthly Budget Review FY2025 values (deficit $1.8T, down $41B / 2%; revenues +$317B / 6%; outlays +$275B / 4%; deficit 5.9% vs 6.3% of GDP; debt held by the public 99.8% vs 97.4% of GDP). The report prose is composed around those figures because cbo.gov blocks automated verbatim retrieval (HTTP 403); the clean version's internal arithmetic was verified consistent before injecting defects. Defects are internal-arithmetic inconsistencies findable from the text's own numbers.
